metadata.scenario: A potential customer inquires about pricing for a customized service package and requests a formal quotation. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Charles Thompson. I'm calling to discuss a customized service package for my post-surgery care. Hi Charles! It’s great to hear from you. How can I assist you with the service package? Well, I was thinking about adding some additional services to my current care plan, but I need a quote first. Absolutely, I can help with that. What specific services are you considering adding? I’d like to know about skilled nursing, possibly some physical therapy, and maybe companion care. Got it! So for skilled nursing care, the price ranges from $95 to $125 for a 1-2 hour visit. That’s good to know. And what about physical therapy? Physical therapy is priced between $110 and $140 for a 45-60 minute session. Okay, and how much for the companion care? Companion care costs $25 to $30 per hour. Thanks, Margaret. I’m trying to keep the costs manageable. Could you help me put together a quote for those services? Certainly, Charles. Let me summarize: skilled nursing, physical therapy, and companion care. How many hours do you envision for each service? I think I’d like 2 hours of skilled nursing, 1 hour of physical therapy, and maybe 3 hours of companion care weekly. Great. So, for skilled nursing, that would be about $190 to $250 weekly. Okay, got that. For physical therapy, it would be $110 to $140 weekly. Alright. And companion care? Companion care would total $75 to $90 weekly. So, what’s the total for the week? Adding everything up, your total weekly cost would range from $375 to $480. That’s manageable for me. Can I get a formal quote for this? Of course! I can send that to you via email today. Can you confirm your email address? Yes, it’s charlesthompson@example.com. Perfect! I’ll prepare the quote and send it right away. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help. You’re very welcome, Charles. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s it for now. I look forward to receiving the quote. Excellent! I’ll get that to you shortly. Have a great day! You too, Margaret. Bye! Bye, Charles!
